ai_summary: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited (formerly Bartronics India Limited) has scheduled a Board Meeting for October 23, 2026, to consider proposals for raising funds through various methods, including the issuance of equity or other securities. This initiative indicates a potential move to bolster the company's financial position, though investors should note the risk of shareholder dilution depending on the chosen fundraising mode. The ongoing closure of the trading window, ahead of the Q2/H1 FY2027 financial results, is a standard regulatory measure with no immediate red flags identified.
